query: INSERT INTO merge_candidates (id, series_id, candidate_id, score, signals, reason) VALUES ($1, LEAST($2::uuid, $3::uuid), GREATEST($2::uuid, $3::uuid), $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (series_id, candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET score = EXCLUDED.score, signals = EXCLUDED.signals, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, updated_at = now() WHERE NOT merge_candidates.resolved RETURNING id
